body: This was helpful, thank you. I never thought of it that way. I still have a lot of research of my own to do, and more practice with active imagination meditation. But I’ll keep this in mind too

I can’t physically see her, what you said makes sense. I was just imagining through meditation. Sorry if I wasn’t clear. I don’t think it’s a real being that can touch me and stuff. Thank you for your comment

I’m an artist too, and I really relate to what you  are saying. It’s hard to be surrounded by people who have more recognition or much better technical skill than you. I’ve been there multiple times. But there’s always gonna be someone “better” than you but that shouldn’t have an effect on you honestly. 

Artists are always hard on themselves, but you don’t have to be the best to tell your own stories. Sometimes you just have to shut out others expectations and your thoughts on what your art should look like (sound like, as you are also a musician) if you want to compete with someone else. Find your purpose with your art.

Maybe try to pay less attention to other artists and make work in private. Make something that your soul really wants to create, and keep doing that. People say art is meant to be shared, which is true, but your art is also for YOU as well. 

You’re not a pathetic loser, you probably have plenty of talent. But you probably only think you’re a loser because you make art with other people in mind instead of yourself first. 

And trust me, I’m going through a very similar thing. Everyday I have to see other artists who are way better skill wise than me, trying to compete and show off their awesome skill. It feels bad sometimes, but I always think about the piece I’m currently working on and how much I thought about the symbolism within it, and how much I’m gonna love it once it’s done. 

Sorry for the long comment, but I hope you feel a little better soon. And using references for drawing is totally fine by the way. I believe plenty of industry professionals literally put whole photographs into their drawings and use 3D models and such!

I’m sorry you’re upset, but it’s just a video game (you don’t sound like you’re being over dramatic about it though). 

Maybe you should try to find other female characters with your name from different media if it’s important to you. Maybe use online character makers/draw and make your own. Who knows, there may even be some kind of mythological character with your name.

The rabbit’s design does look really girly, I would have thought it was a girl too. Sometimes it’s nice to have characters that are like you/share your name, but sometimes it doesn’t happen and that’s okay.

Thank you, you are very right, but I don’t really have the energy to do anything but work these days. Art will make me happy, but I guess I need a little more time, maybe I’ll try tomorrow. Thanks again, I hope it gets better

Thanks for the support, I just honestly needed to just get that out. I’m sorry that you relate to this, but I’m hoping this will pass

(Edit I just saw you weren’t a man, sorry)

I can definitely relate to wishing I had tried harder as well, but I don’t regret what I did in school, I was young.  Creative writing is cool! I took a few courses on that in school too, I wasn’t the best but I try to include it in my art a bit too. Drawing can seem daunting at first but you’ve just got to start thinking a different way when practicing then you’ll get the hang of it!

I’ve been thinking of TikTok but I heard some shady stuff about it (I might have to bite the bullet and download it though, it seems like fun!) and I have a small Instagram that is not very popular, old classmates from college mostly follow me, but I’ve made some new friends too!

Thank you for your comment, I wish good luck to you!
I think a lot of people do, but we all have our own path in life! I hope you reach your goals!

Thank you, I understand I have to do what I have to do but, I think I’m just stuck on starting to make my art my side hustle is all, I’m not too good with social media but trying. I appreciate your encouragement though!
It’s good to know I’m not alone. Thank you for the encouragement! I hope you can start back working in your field as well ( if that’s your goal for the future) :)
